source_refs.note: Topic 24.5 (PDF 223). The portrait of Lamarck (Figure 24.7) is not reproduced; the sentence 'an early proponent of the idea that evolution' is read as of the idea of evolution.

blocks.text: The French naturalist Jean-Baptiste Lamarck (1744-1829) was an early supporter of the idea of evolution. In his view organisms changed from the simplest to more complex forms, and changes arise in organisms as they adapt to their environment.
